description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the PimCsvDataImport component within the OrangeHRM system. It tests the import functionality of CSV data into employee entities, verifying scenarios like successful import, handling missing fields, duplications, and gender value mappings.

classes.name: PimCsvDataImportTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing CSV import functionality related to employee data in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by truncating specific tables and instantiating the data import object.

methods.name: testGetNationalityService
methods.description: Verifies that the getNationalityService method returns an instance of NationalityService.

methods.name: testGetCountryService
methods.description: Verifies that the getCountryService method returns an instance of CountryService.

methods.name: testIsValidPhoneNumber
methods.description: Checks the validity of provided phone number strings.

methods.name: testImportWhenSuccessful
methods.description: Simulates a successful import of employee data and verifies the process completes correctly using mock services.

methods.name: testImportWhenSuccessfulWhenGenderValueChanges
methods.description: Tests import functionality when gender value differs ('Male'/'Female') and data is processed correctly.

methods.name: testImportWhenFirstNameNotExist
methods.description: Tests import failure when the first name field is empty.

methods.name: testImportWhenLastNameNotExist
methods.description: Tests import failure when the last name field is empty.

methods.name: testImportWhenEmployeeIdDuplicated
methods.description: Verifies that duplicate employee IDs prevent subsequent imports, ensuring data integrity.
